बॉक्स ऑफिस पर नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म Ramayana का जलवा!
4 दिन के लम्बे ओपनिंग वीकेंड में फिल्म ने कमाए 242 करोड़ नेट।
Koimoi Director Ranking में नितेश तिवारी को मिले कुल 650 पॉइंट्स।
उन्होंने Sanjay Leela Bhansali और Laxman Utekar को पीछे छोड़ दिया है।
Dangal की कमाई 387.39 करोड़ होने की वजह से वे Kabir Khan से आगे 11वें नंबर पर हैं।
क्या आने वाले दिनों में यह फिल्म 300 करोड़ क्लब में शामिल होगी?

#CineChaska #Ramayana #NiteshTiwari #BoxOffice #BollywoodNews #SanjayLeelaBhansali #Dangal

ctx.title: Box Office: Nitesh Tiwari Overtakes Sanjay Leela Bhansali & 2 Others In Director Ranking As Ramayana Enters 200 Crore Net Club!
ctx.summary:
After Chhichhore, Nitesh Tiwari returns to the big screen with Ramayana and is letting his work do all the talking at the box office. 
 The post  Box Office: Nitesh Tiwari Overtakes Sanjay Leela Bhansali & 2 Others In Director Ranking As Ramayana Enters 200 Crore Net Club!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Ramayana is smashing records at the Indian box office, with the pre-Diwali period barrier now gone. However, even with the pre-Diwali factor in play, the magnum opus raked in strong numbers, amassing 242 crore net in its 4-day extended opening weekend. With such numbers, director Nitesh Tiwari has witnessed an increment in Koimoi Director Ranking’s points table, allowing him to surpass Sanjay Leela Bhansali and other big guns. Keep reading for a detailed report!
Indian directors are judged based on their Hindi/ Bollywood films in the coveted clubs – 100 crores, 200 crores, and so on. So, in Koimoi Director Ranking, 100 points will be awarded to directors for each film in the 100-crore club. Similarly, 200 points are awarded for a film in the 200-crore club, etc. For each movie in the top 10 overseas grossers, a filmmaker earns 50 points.
With Ramayana entering the 100 crore net club at the Indian box office, Nitesh Tiwari gained 100 points, helping him secure the 14th spot in Koimoi Director Ranking. Now, with the film entering the 200 crore net club on its 4th day, the director has gained 100 more points. With this, his total now stands at 650 .
With 650 points, Nitesh Tiwari has surpassed Sanjay Leela Bhansali ( 600 points ), Laxman Utekar ( 600 points ), and Kabir Khan ( 650 points ). Despite being tied with Kabir, Nitesh has been ranked higher, at the 11th spot, because his highest-grosser, Dangal ( 387.39 crore ), has a higher net collection than Kabir’s top grosser, Bajrangi Bhaijaan ( 320.34 crore ).
With Ramayana now picking up the pace, the director is set to make big gains in the coming days.
